messages:
alexa: quick sync — we need to finalize acceptance for the Acme pilot. customer asks: actionable batching/caching recs, quant profiles for mobile tier, and eval-triggered alerts. i sketched a lean scope below. TL;DR: 2-week pilot, canary + metrics, stop-gap rollback plan.

sam: can we scope the batching recs to 3 prescriptive knobs? e.g. max_batch_delay, seq_len_cutoff, dynamic_batch_window. keep defaults safe.

maria: +1. for quant profiles propose 2 levels: q8 for latency-sensitive (some quality loss allowed), q4-hybrid for cost-focused with eval gating. need eval baselines.

raj: from CS: Acme will only run on dedicated for pilot, wants on-prem parity. they want clear roll-back and a list of example prompts we'll use for evals.

ellen: confirming — Acme provided 1200 sample prompts, 20 critical vignettes flagged. they want alerting on >5% semantic drift vs baseline and any p99 latency regressions >200ms.

nitesh: SRE constraints: canary must not exceed 30% of capacity. we need a default fallback policy to a compatible model variant. also require per-tenant KV cache TTLs to be configurable.

alexa: proposed acceptance criteria (short):
- Functional: toolkit suggests batching configs for top 3 call patterns and writes a JSON recommendation per route.
- Quality: for each quant profile, mean EM/ROUGE drop <= 2% on customer vignettes; any regression triggers eval-alert.
- Performance: end-to-end p95 token latency <= target (tier-specific), and p99 for mobile tier unchanged or improved.
- Observability: telemetry surfaced in console per-route + alerting into Slack/PagerDuty.

sam: example output shape for recommendations (one-liner):
```\n{\n  "route": "/chat",\n  "recommendations": [\n    {"max_batch_delay_ms": 8, "batch_size_hint": 64, "kv_cache_policy": "prefetch_prefix"}\n  ]\n}\n```
(we'll keep this small; prod format will be wider)

maria: eval-triggered alerts design idea: 3 alert types — quality-regress (stat threshold), latency-degradation, and econ-signal (tokens/unit cost deviation). each alert includes diff, sample failing prompts, and suggested mitigations (rollback, increase batch size, switch q-profile).

raj: negotiation note with Acme: they prefer no default q8 on critical routes. propose we mark critical vignettes as "must-pass" and never enable aggressive quant there during pilot.

ellen: Acme legal asked about data retention for evals. answer: we store eval artifacts for 30 days and redact PII before analysis. they want this in the runbook.

alexa: rollout plan draft:
1) Week 0: onboarding + baseline eval (run 1200 prompts).
2) Week 1: enable batching/caching recommendations in canary (10-30% traffic). run A/B evals nightly.
3) Week 2: enable quant profile on non-critical routes + continuous eval alerts.
4) Post-pilot: collect acceptance metrics; if pass -> expand to dedicated production.

nitesh: canary and automatic fallback pseudo-config:
```\ncanary: {"pct": 20, "fallback_on": ["p99_latency_increase>150ms", "quality_drop>2%"]}\n```
we'll wire alerts to ops channel.

sam: tradeoffs for product to sign off: initial MVP will not do per-prompt adaptive quantization. that's a later stretch.

maria: also call out eval time budget: running full eval nightly is expensive. propose a sampled nightly eval (200 prompts) + full weekly eval.

raj: commercial ask: if pilot shows >10% unit cost reduction we get favorable pricing commit. will surface at handoff.

ellen: customer success will draft the runbook — we'll include rollback steps, legal data retention, and a short FAQ for Acme's infra team.

alexa: open items before we close scope:
- sam: confirm exact knobs we expose (3).
- maria: baseline eval scripts + metrics (EM, ROUGE, embedding-sim).
- nitesh: enforce canary limit + alert wiring.
- raj/ellen: agree wording with Acme on critical vignettes and data retention.

any objections to locking this scope? prefer to lock by EOD so eng can sprint next week.

sam: no objections. locking w/ noted open items. :white_check_mark:

maria: +1. i'll start writing eval harness.

raj: i'll take the customer confirmation.

ellen: will draft runbook and share.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled by ops for 3400070000. Job: canary-optimize-toolkit-v1.

alexa: perfect — thanks all. i'll put a short acceptance checklist in the pilot PR and tag owners.

(ends)
